description: Comprehensive schema dictionary and business rules catalog for AutoVyn ERP core tables

name_at_bank.description: Registered account holder name returned by bank

raw_response.description: Full raw JSON payload from bank gateway

Approval_Matrix.description: Multi-tier approval hierarchy (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3) with primary and alternate approvers for attendance, leaves, and expenses.

empcode.description: Employee code being approved (links to EMPLOYEEMASTER.EMPCODE)

Asset_Issue.description: Manages IT and physical assets (Laptops, Desktops, Phones, Vehicles) assigned to employees with issue and return dates.

Issue_Date.description: Date asset was handed over to employee

Revoke_Date.description: Return date (NULL if currently held by employee)

COMP_KEYDATA.description: Centralized company-level system configuration and module toggles (Sales, Service, HRMS, Accounts, WhatsApp, Approval limits).

COMP_OFF_DTL.description: Tracks employee Compensatory Off credits earned by working on Weekly Offs/Holidays, approvals, and balance days.

laps_date.description: Expiry date after which credit lapses

Comp_Mst.description: Legal company identity, registered office address, GSTIN, CIN, OEM Dealership code, and financial locking dates.

State_Code.description: GST state code (08 for RJ, 07 for DL)

Lock_Date.description: Financial backdate entry lock cutoff date

EMPLOYEE_BALANCE.description: Employee salary advances, company loan repayments, and scheduled monthly payroll deductions.

EMP_DOCS.description: Stores employee KYC files, onboarding documents, and GPS camera photos submitted for Misspunch attendance regularization.

Emp_Ded.description: Monthly itemized payroll deductions (TDS, Loan EMIs, Advance recovery, Fines) and salary component arrears.

Emp_Incentive.description: Vehicle sales commission, accessories incentives, service target bonuses, advance adjustments, and net disbursement.

Incentive_Type.description: Incentive category (Car Sales, MGA, EW, Finance)

Emp_Slryrun.description: Logs monthly payroll computation execution batches, iteration cycles (Rerun), and HR admin audit timestamps.

Employee_AtnStatus.displayName: Attendance Status Codes & Pay Weights Master
Employee_AtnStatus.description: Master table defining attendance symbols (P, A, WO, HD, PL, WOP, H), day pay weights (1.0, 0.5, 0.0, 2.0), penalty days, and UI colors.

Status.description: Attendance status code (P, A, WO, HD, PL, WOP, H, LWP)

colorCode.description: HEX color code for UI calendar badge

FullFinal_Adjustments.description: Calculates exit settlements, gratuity payouts, leave encashment, notice period recoveries, and loan clearances for relieved staff.

Notice_Pay_Recovery.description: Notice pay deducted for short notice

Godown_Mst.description: Complete dealership branch network, showroom addresses, workshop service centers, parts godowns, GSTINs, and bank details.

IFSC_CODE_API.description: National directory of all RBI registered bank branches with IFSC, MICR, address, city, and NEFT/RTGS/IMPS/UPI capabilities.

NewCar_Sale_Register.description: Core commercial and tax invoicing register for all new car deliveries, customer details, VIN/Chassis numbers, models, and GST tax.

REPORT_MST.displayName: Dynamic Report Builder & Column Mapping Master
REPORT_MST.description: Configures dynamic report engine layouts, column display names, sorting sequences (field_seq), and report module blocks.

SalaryReportTemplate.description: Saves user-defined salary report configurations with selected field arrays (referencing REPORT_MST) and location filters.

selected_fields.description: JSON array of REPORT_MST.UTD field IDs

location_fields.description: JSON array of Branch Location codes

machinerawpunch.description: Raw biometric punch logs captured from physical fingerprint scanners, RFID smart card readers, and turnstiles.

overtime_policy.description: Configures Overtime calculation minute slabs and pro-rata payable day weight multipliers (PValue).

SALARYSTRUCTURE.description: Employee agreed monthly CTC Gross Salary and component breakdown (Basic, HRA, Conveyance, Medical, Washing, Other).

SALARYFILE.displayName: Monthly Processed Salary & Payroll Payslip Register
SALARYFILE.description: Monthly calculated and locked payroll register containing actual earned salary components (Gross_Earn, Basic_Earn, HRA_Earn, Total_Earn, Final_Payment) and payroll attendance (Present_days, Monthdays, Total_Days) for each employee.
queryRules: CRITICAL: For actual monthly payout/earnings, ALWAYS query Gross_Earn, Basic_Earn, HRA_Earn, CONVEN_Earn, Medical_Earn, Other_Earn, Total_Earn, and Final_Payment.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use Gross or Basic as monthly earned salary — Gross and Basic are fixed master monthly CTC before attendance deduction.
For payroll attendance: Use Present_days for days worked, Monthdays for total days in month, and Total_Days for payable days.
To filter specific month and year: WHERE Emp_Code = @empCode AND SalMnth = @monthNum AND salyear = @yearStr.

Monthdays.description: Total calendar days in the salary month (28, 29, 30, 31)

Present_days.description: Actual present/working days worked by employee in this month

Off_days.description: Weekly off days in this month

Total_Days.description: Total payable days for salary calculation (Present_days + Off_days + Holiday_Leaves)

Gross_Earn.description: ACTUAL Gross salary EARNED for this month based on attendance (e.g. 5305.00)

Basic_Earn.description: ACTUAL Basic salary EARNED for this month

HRA_Earn.description: ACTUAL HRA EARNED for this month

CONVEN_Earn.description: ACTUAL Conveyance allowance EARNED for this month

Medical_Earn.description: ACTUAL Medical allowance EARNED for this month

Other_Earn.description: ACTUAL Other allowances EARNED for this month

Total_Earn.description: ACTUAL Total earnings for this month before deductions

Final_Payment.description: ACTUAL Net In-Hand Take-Home Salary transferred/payable to bank account

Gross.description: Fixed Master Monthly Gross CTC rate (before attendance proration, e.g. 11750.00)

Other.description: Fixed Master Monthly Other Allowance rate

Arrear.description: Arrear payment additions for previous months

Deducation.description: Total monthly deductions (PF + ESI + TDS + Advance + Loan + Other)

Account_No.description: Employee Bank Account Number for salary credit

Loc_Code.description: Branch Location Code (Links to Misc_Mst.Misc_Code WHERE Misc_Type = 85)

ABSENTVALUE.description: Actual Absent Days in this salary month (e.g. 18.00)

LEAVEVALUE.description: Actual Leave Days in this salary month

EMPLOYEEMASTER.description: Master table for all employee personal, departmental, banking, statutory compliance (PF/ESIC/PAN/Aadhar), and employment lifecycle details.
queryRules: Always filter by EXPORT_TYPE = compcode for multi-tenant isolation.
To get active employees only, add: WHERE STATUS = 1 OR STATUS IS NULL.
Join with Misc_Mst to get branch names: LEFT JOIN Misc_Mst branch ON branch.Misc_Code = EMPLOYEEMASTER.LOCATION AND branch.Misc_Type = 85
Join with Misc_Mst to get department names: LEFT JOIN Misc_Mst dept ON dept.Misc_Code = EMPLOYEEMASTER.DEPT AND dept.Misc_Type = 11
Join with Misc_Mst to get designation names: LEFT JOIN Misc_Mst desg ON desg.Misc_Code = EMPLOYEEMASTER.DESG AND desg.Misc_Type = 95

EMPCODE.description: Unique Employee Code (e.g. EMP001, 10243). Primary identifier across all HR and payroll tables

EMPLASTNAME.description: Last name / surname of the employee

DATE_OF_LEAVING.description: Date of leaving / resignation if inactive

LOCATION.description: Branch / Location Code (Links to Misc_Mst.Misc_Code WHERE Misc_Type = 85)

DEPT.description: Department Code (Links to Misc_Mst.Misc_Code WHERE Misc_Type = 11)

DESG.description: Designation Code (Links to Misc_Mst.Misc_Code WHERE Misc_Type = 95)

GRADE.description: Employee Grade Code (Links to Misc_Mst.Misc_Code WHERE Misc_Type = 672)

attendancetable.description: Monthly pivoted attendance register holding day-by-day status codes (P1 through P31), aggregated present, absent, week-off, and final payable days.
queryRules: Join with EMPLOYEEMASTER on attendancetable.Empcode = EMPLOYEEMASTER.EMPCODE.

monthdays.description: Total number of calendar days in this month (28, 29, 30, 31)

P1.description: Attendance status code for Day 1 (P=Present, A=Absent, W=WeekOff, CL=Casual Leave, etc.)

tot_woff.description: Total Week Off Days in Month

payable_days.description: Final calculated payable days for monthly salary processing
